notes.title: Burly Men at Sea 1.4.5
notes.content:
This is a minor, but nonetheless important, release to keep the game running smoothly into the future. We've corrected some minor localization issues (thanks to the fan community for these!), eliminated a few small bugs, and updated the engine and Steamworks integration.

Questions, comments, high-fives? Email us at support@brainandbrain.co.

notes.title: Three new languages!
notes.content:
Our bearded brothers have picked up a few new languages in their travels, mastering Korean, Turkish, and Polish to bring the total number of languages supported to 13!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26021311/ad0d30ca3e2949d1844e7f9635c94d4c372794e8.png[/img]

The Turkish and Polish localizations were made possible by the fan community. Special thanks to the students at Istanbul University, and Mateusz Wcisło! It's exciting to be able to bring our seafaring adventure to more people.

If you'd like to support Brain&Brain even without masterful translation skills, you can become a patron on [url=https://www.patreon.com/brainandbrain]Patreon[/url]! We post every 1–2 weeks, giving you exclusive behind-the-scenes content on our latest project, [url=https://visitwoodennickel.com]Wooden Nickel[/url].

notes.title: The best game soundtracks you can listen to for free right now
notes.content:
Another month, another big video game publisher puts a great big dollop of video game music online for zero pennies. This time, it’s Bandai Namco, who have just uploaded every single Tekken soundtrack onto Spotify because, well, apparently everyone loves Tekken. I’ve never partaken in a Tekken, but with track names like “Massive Stunner” and “Lonesome City Jazz Party 1st”, I’m already 100% convinced the music must be great.

However, given my rather lacking expertise in all things Tekken-related, I thought that instead of doing a big Tekken musical breakdown like I did for Capcom and all the Final Fantasy games, I’d take this opportunity to celebrate some of the other great gaming soundtracks you can currently listen to for free right now, because boy howdy are there loads of ’em. So bang on those headphones and turn up the volume, folks. It’s head-banging time.

notes.title: Have You Played Burly Men at Sea?
notes.content:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time…

You’ve got to admire the courage of Brain&Brain‘s three burly men at sea. If I knew I was going to get swallowed whole by a massive whale every time I set sail for adventure, I think I’d stay at home. But that’s not what being burly is about. Instead, these bearded brothers are willing to throw themselves down the gullet of adventure time and time again in a Groundhog Day-style time loop just to see where the wind will take them next. And it’s really quite delightful.

notes.title: Burly Men at Sea head for bookshelves
notes.content: Burly Men At Sea‘s [official site] was one of my Games Of The Year for 2016. The developers, Brain&Brain bill it as a quiet adventure and I tend to describe it as an interactive storybook. You’re in charge of the voyages of the Brothers Beard and your choices and interactions guide them through tiny adventures at sea. But now you can have one of those adventures made into a hardback book if you want something for your actual bookshelf. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Achievements! Italian! SALE?!
notes.content:
Ever since our beardy fellas received that honorable mention for [url=http://www.igf.com/finalists-and-winners]IGF's Excellence in Narrative[/url] award, they've been clamoring for some way to keep track of their achievements. And something about a quit button. Fine.

Today's update adds the following:
[list]
    [*]Achievements
    [*]Italian localization
    [*]Steam Controller config
    [*]Steam Cloud support
    [*]Quit button
    [*]Bug fixes and polish
[/list]

AND for the first time, Burly Men at Sea is 30% off!

notes.title: Burly Men at Sea available now!
notes.content:
“It’s a tiny-but-then-not-tiny, lovely thing with so much character and a wonderful sense of adventure," says [url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2016/09/30/burly-men-at-sea-review/]Rock, Paper, Shotgun[/url].

"5/5," proclaims [url=http://time.com/4510322/burly-men-at-sea-review/]TIME[/url], for its "artful interplay of visual minimalism, waggish writing and hilarious but also haunting sound effects generated by gorgeous a cappella voices."

"It’s a calming, lovely game," adds [url=http://kotaku.com/burly-men-at-sea-is-a-small-game-about-shipwrecks-1787235002]Kotaku[/url]. "It left me with a little smile on my face."

"Aye!" grin the Brothers Beard as they set sail.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26021311/02414e884af0066e68a1c6d9297a46bc4289a8b1.png[/img]
